## 1. Load the Selection 

```{r load-data}
sel   <- readRDS(SEL_FILE)
fit   <- as.data.table(sel$fit)
calib <- as.data.table(sel$calib)
test  <- as.data.table(sel$test)

to_int5 <- function(d) { d[, rating5 := as.integer(as.character(rating5))]; d[] }
fit <- to_int5(fit); calib <- to_int5(calib); test <- to_int5(test)

user_map  <- data.table(userId  = sort(unique(fit$userId)))[,  user_idx  := .I]
movie_map <- data.table(movieId = sort(unique(fit$movieId)))[, movie_idx := .I]
add_idx <- function(d) {
  d <- merge(d, user_map,  by = "userId",  all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  d <- merge(d, movie_map, by = "movieId", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  setDT(d)
  d[, cold := is.na(user_idx) | is.na(movie_idx)]
  d[]
}
fit   <- add_idx(fit)[cold == FALSE]
calib <- add_idx(calib)[cold == FALSE]
test  <- add_idx(test)[cold == FALSE]

nU <- nrow(user_map); nI <- nrow(movie_map)
cat(sprintf("fit %d | calib %d | test %d | users %d | movies %d\n",
            nrow(fit), nrow(calib), nrow(test), nU, nI))
stopifnot(nrow(fit) == 393364L)   # guard against loading a stale selection
```

---

## 2. Core Functions



```{r core-functions}
sigmoid <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-pmin(pmax(x, -30), 30)))

# ---- global-threshold OrdRec (verbatim from 09, used to score M2d) ---
expand_thresholds <- function(t1, beta) c(t1, t1 + cumsum(exp(beta)))

calc_scores_d <- function(par, u, i)
  par$bi[i] + par$bu[u] + rowSums(par$P[u, , drop = FALSE] *
                                  par$Q[i, , drop = FALSE])

ordrec_probs_d <- function(par, u, i) {
  y  <- calc_scores_d(par, u, i)
  th <- expand_thresholds(par$t1, par$beta)
  CP <- sapply(th, function(t) plogis(t - y))
  if (is.null(dim(CP))) CP <- matrix(CP, nrow = length(y))
  cbind(CP[, 1], CP[, 2:4] - CP[, 1:3], 1 - CP[, 4])
}

# ---- per-user OrdRec (M2e) -------------------------------------------
# par$t1  : numeric length nU      (user-specific t_1)
# par$beta: matrix  nU x 3         (user-specific log-gaps)
# par$bi  : numeric length nI      (item biases; there is NO b_u)
# par$P   : nU x dim, par$Q : nI x dim

calc_scores_e <- function(par, u, i)
  par$bi[i] + rowSums(par$P[u, , drop = FALSE] * par$Q[i, , drop = FALSE])

# Threshold rows for the given user vector: one 4-vector per row of u.
user_threshold_rows <- function(par, u) {
  E <- exp(par$beta[u, , drop = FALSE])          # length(u) x 3
  t1 <- par$t1[u]
  cbind(t1,
        t1 + E[, 1],
        t1 + E[, 1] + E[, 2],
        t1 + E[, 1] + E[, 2] + E[, 3])
}

ordrec_forward_e <- function(y, r, Tmat) {
  n <- length(y)
  g_hi <- ifelse(r == K_LEVELS, 1,
                 sigmoid(Tmat[cbind(seq_len(n), pmin(r, K_LEVELS - 1L))] - y))
  g_lo <- ifelse(r == 1L, 0,
                 sigmoid(Tmat[cbind(seq_len(n), pmax(r - 1L, 1L))] - y))
  A <- g_hi * (1 - g_hi)
  B <- g_lo * (1 - g_lo)
  list(prob = pmax(g_hi - g_lo, 1e-12), A = A, B = B)
}

ordrec_mean_ll_e <- function(par, dat) {
  y  <- calc_scores_e(par, dat$u, dat$i)
  Tm <- user_threshold_rows(par, dat$u)
  mean(log(ordrec_forward_e(y, dat$r, Tm)$prob))
}

ordrec_probs_e <- function(par, u, i) {
  y  <- calc_scores_e(par, u, i)
  Tm <- user_threshold_rows(par, u)
  CP <- plogis(Tm - y)          # n x 4 minus length-n vector: recycles by column, correct
  cbind(CP[, 1], CP[, 2:4] - CP[, 1:3], 1 - CP[, 4])
}

# ---- metrics, verbatim from 07/09 ------------------------------------
tidy_probs <- function(P) { P <- pmax(P, 1e-12); P / rowSums(P) }

gauss_probs <- function(y, sigma) {
  y  <- as.numeric(y)
  CP <- sapply(CUTS, function(c) pnorm((c - y) / sigma))
  if (is.null(dim(CP))) CP <- matrix(CP, nrow = length(y))
  cbind(CP[, 1], CP[, 2:4] - CP[, 1:3], 1 - CP[, 4])
}

cum_probs <- function(theta, eta) {
  eta <- as.numeric(eta)
  CP  <- sapply(theta, function(t) plogis(t - eta))
  if (is.null(dim(CP))) CP <- matrix(CP, nrow = length(eta))
  cbind(CP[, 1], CP[, 2:4] - CP[, 1:3], 1 - CP[, 4])
}

metric_set <- function(P, y) {
  y   <- as.integer(y); P <- tidy_probs(P); n <- nrow(P)
  ll  <- log(P[cbind(seq_len(n), y)])
  E   <- as.numeric(P %*% LEVELS5)
  CP  <- t(apply(P, 1, cumsum))
  IND <- outer(y, LEVELS5, function(a, b) as.numeric(a <= b))
  rps <- rowSums((CP[, 1:(K_LEVELS - 1)] - IND[, 1:(K_LEVELS - 1)])^2) / (K_LEVELS - 1)
  list(row_ll = ll,
       tbl = data.table(meanLL = mean(ll),
                        RMSE   = sqrt(mean((y - E)^2)),
                        RPS    = mean(rps),
                        CatAcc = mean(max.col(P, ties.method = "first") == y)))
}

ndcg_at_10 <- function(score, y, uid, min_items = 5L) {
  d <- data.table(uid = uid, s = as.numeric(score), rel = 2^as.integer(y) - 1)
  d <- d[, if (.N >= min_items) .SD, by = uid]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  per_user <- d[, {
    k    <- min(10L, .N)
    dcg  <- sum(rel[order(-s)][1:k]   / log2(seq_len(k) + 1))
    idcg <- sum(rel[order(-rel)][1:k] / log2(seq_len(k) + 1))
    .(ndcg = if (idcg > 0) dcg / idcg else NA_real_)
  }, by = uid]
  mean(per_user$ndcg, na.rm = TRUE)
}

fcp_stat <- function(score, y, uid, min_items = 5L) {
  d <- data.table(uid = uid, s = as.numeric(score), y = as.integer(y))
  d <- d[, if (.N >= min_items) .SD, by = uid]
  if (nrow(d) == 0)
    return(list(FCP = NA_real_, nc = 0L, nd = 0L, n_pairs = 0L, n_users = 0L))
  per_user <- d[, {
    sy_gt <- outer(y, y, `>`); sy_lt <- outer(y, y, `<`)
    ss_gt <- outer(s, s, `>`); ss_ge <- outer(s, s, `>=`)
    list(nc = sum(ss_gt & sy_gt), nd = sum(ss_ge & sy_lt))
  }, by = uid]
  nc <- sum(per_user$nc); nd <- sum(per_user$nd)
  list(FCP = nc / (nc + nd), nc = nc, nd = nd,
       n_pairs = nc + nd, n_users = uniqueN(d$uid))
}
```

## 3. The Mini-Batch SGD Trainer (Per-User Thresholds)



```{r trainer}
train_ordrec_m2e <- function(dat_fit, dat_calib, init, eta, lambda,
                             batch_size = BATCH_SIZE, max_epochs = MAX_EPOCHS,
                             patience = PATIENCE, seed = SEED, clip = CLIP,
                             eta_decay = ETA_DECAY, verbose = TRUE) {
  par <- init
  n <- length(dat_fit$u)
  best <- list(ll = -Inf, par = par, epoch = 0L)
  hist <- data.table(epoch = integer(), fit_meanLL = numeric(),
                     calib_meanLL = numeric(), clip_rate = numeric())
  set.seed(seed)
  eta_e <- eta
  for (ep in seq_len(max_epochs)) {
    perm <- sample.int(n)
    n_clip <- 0L
    for (b0 in seq(1L, n, by = batch_size)) {
      idx <- perm[b0:min(b0 + batch_size - 1L, n)]
      u <- dat_fit$u[idx]; i <- dat_fit$i[idx]; r <- dat_fit$r[idx]

      y  <- calc_scores_e(par, u, i)
      E  <- exp(par$beta[u, , drop = FALSE])            # length(u) x 3
      t1v <- par$t1[u]
      Tm <- cbind(t1v, t1v + E[, 1], t1v + E[, 1] + E[, 2],
                  t1v + E[, 1] + E[, 2] + E[, 3])
      fw <- ordrec_forward_e(y, r, Tm)
      c_hi <- fw$A / fw$prob; c_lo <- fw$B / fw$prob
      n_clip <- n_clip + sum(c_hi > clip) + sum(c_lo > clip)
      c_hi <- pmin(c_hi, clip); c_lo <- pmin(c_lo, clip)
      dy <- c_lo - c_hi                                 # dl/dy per row

      # per-user thresholds: batch-SUM over each user's rows (see note above)
      g_t1 <- rowsum(c_hi - c_lo, u)
      g_b1 <- rowsum(E[, 1] * (c_hi * (1L <= r - 1L) - c_lo * (1L <= r - 2L)), u)
      g_b2 <- rowsum(E[, 2] * (c_hi * (2L <= r - 1L) - c_lo * (2L <= r - 2L)), u)
      g_b3 <- rowsum(E[, 3] * (c_hi * (3L <= r - 1L) - c_lo * (3L <= r - 2L)), u)
      ug <- as.integer(rownames(g_t1))                  # same grouping for all four
      par$t1[ug]      <- par$t1[ug]      + eta_e * as.numeric(g_t1)
      par$beta[ug, 1] <- par$beta[ug, 1] + eta_e * as.numeric(g_b1)
      par$beta[ug, 2] <- par$beta[ug, 2] + eta_e * as.numeric(g_b2)
      par$beta[ug, 3] <- par$beta[ug, 3] + eta_e * as.numeric(g_b3)

      # user factors: batch-SUM, per-occurrence L2 (no b_u to update)
      SP <- rowsum(dy * par$Q[i, , drop = FALSE], u)
      nu <- as.numeric(rowsum(rep(1, length(u)), u))
      par$P[ug, ] <- par$P[ug, ] + eta_e * (SP - lambda * nu * par$P[ug, , drop = FALSE])

      # items: unchanged from 09
      si <- rowsum(dy, i); ig <- as.integer(rownames(si))
      ni <- as.numeric(rowsum(rep(1, length(i)), i))
      par$bi[ig] <- par$bi[ig] + eta_e * (as.numeric(si) - lambda * ni * par$bi[ig])
      SQ <- rowsum(dy * par$P[u, , drop = FALSE], i)
      par$Q[ig, ] <- par$Q[ig, ] + eta_e * (SQ - lambda * ni * par$Q[ig, , drop = FALSE])

      if (any(!is.finite(par$t1[ug])) || any(!is.finite(par$beta[ug, ])))
        return(list(diverged = TRUE, best_ll = -Inf, best_epoch = 0L,
                    history = hist))
    }
    ll_c <- ordrec_mean_ll_e(par, dat_calib)
    ll_f <- ordrec_mean_ll_e(par, dat_fit)
    hist <- rbind(hist, data.table(epoch = ep, fit_meanLL = ll_f,
                                   calib_meanLL = ll_c, clip_rate = n_clip / n))
    if (verbose) cat(sprintf("    epoch %2d  fit %.5f  calib %.5f  clip %.5f%%\n",
                             ep, ll_f, ll_c, 100 * n_clip / n))
    if (ll_c > best$ll + 1e-5) {
      best <- list(ll = ll_c, par = par, epoch = ep)
    } else if (ep - best$epoch >= patience) break
    eta_e <- eta_e * eta_decay
  }
  list(diverged = FALSE, best_ll = best$ll, par = best$par,
       best_epoch = best$epoch, history = hist)
}
```

### Synthetic self-test



```{r trainer-selftest}
set.seed(7)
.nU <- 400L; .nI <- 200L; .K <- 8L
.true <- list(t1   = rnorm(.nU, 0.5, 0.5),
              beta = matrix(rnorm(.nU * 3, rep(log(c(1.2, 1.6, 2.0)), each = .nU), 0.25),
                            .nU, 3),
              bi = rnorm(.nI, 0, 0.5),
              P = matrix(rnorm(.nU * .K, 0, 0.55), .nU, .K),
              Q = matrix(rnorm(.nI * .K, 0, 0.55), .nI, .K))
.gen <- function(n) {
  u <- sample(.nU, n, TRUE); i <- sample(.nI, n, TRUE)
  y  <- calc_scores_e(.true, u, i)
  Tm <- user_threshold_rows(.true, u)
  G  <- cbind(plogis(Tm - y), 1)
  P5 <- cbind(G[, 1], G[, 2:5] - G[, 1:4])
  list(u = u, i = i,
       r = as.integer(apply(P5, 1, function(p) sample.int(5, 1, prob = pmax(p, 0)))))
}
.df <- .gen(60000L); .dc <- .gen(15000L)
.oracle <- ordrec_mean_ll_e(.true, .dc)
.marg   <- prop.table(tabulate(.df$r, 5))
.mll    <- mean(log(.marg[.dc$r]))
.cum    <- qlogis(cumsum(.marg)[1:4])
.cold   <- list(t1   = rep(.cum[1], .nU),
                beta = matrix(log(pmax(diff(.cum), 1e-3)), .nU, 3, byrow = TRUE),
                bi = rep(0, .nI),
                P = matrix(rnorm(.nU * .K, 0, 0.05), .nU, .K),
                Q = matrix(rnorm(.nI * .K, 0, 0.05), .nI, .K))
.res <- train_ordrec_m2e(.df, .dc, .cold, eta = 0.03, lambda = 0.01,
                         verbose = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("synthetic: trained %.5f | oracle %.5f | marginal %.5f\n",
            .res$best_ll, .oracle, .mll))
stopifnot(!.res$diverged, .res$best_ll > .mll + 0.05,
          .res$best_ll > .oracle - 0.08)
cat("TRAINER SELF-TEST: PASS\n")
rm(.df, .dc, .true, .cold, .res)
```

## 4. Baselines from Cache (M1, M2a, M2b, M2c, M2d)



```{r baselines}
svd_cache <- readRDS(file.path(CACHE_DIR, "svd_factors.rds"))
stopifnot(identical(as.integer(svd_cache$user_map$userId),   as.integer(user_map$userId)),
          identical(as.integer(svd_cache$movie_map$movieId), as.integer(movie_map$movieId)),
          svd_cache$dim == SVD_DIM,
          nrow(svd_cache$P) == nU, nrow(svd_cache$Q) == nI)
Pmat <- svd_cache$P; Qmat <- svd_cache$Q
cat(sprintf("Loaded SVD factors from cache (dim=%d, L2=%g)\n",
            svd_cache$dim, svd_cache$l2))

svd_score_vec <- function(u, i)
  rowSums(Pmat[u, , drop = FALSE] * Qmat[i, , drop = FALSE])
calib[, svd_score := svd_score_vec(user_idx, movie_idx)]
test[,  svd_score := svd_score_vec(user_idx, movie_idx)]
calib[, svd_clip := pmin(pmax(svd_score, 1), 5)]
test[,  svd_clip := pmin(pmax(svd_score, 1), 5)]

# M1
sigma_m1 <- sqrt(mean((as.numeric(calib$rating5) - calib$svd_clip)^2))
P_m1 <- gauss_probs(test$svd_clip, sigma_m1)

# M2a / M2b (fast clm fits, as in 09)
calib[, rating_f := factor(rating5, levels = LEVELS5, ordered = TRUE)]
m2a <- clm(rating_f ~ svd_score, data = calib, link = "logit",
           threshold = "equidistant")
m2b <- clm(rating_f ~ svd_score, data = calib, link = "logit",
           threshold = "flexible")
th_a <- as.numeric(m2a$alpha); b_a <- as.numeric(m2a$beta)
th_a <- th_a[1] + (0:3) * th_a[2]
th_b <- as.numeric(m2b$alpha); b_b <- as.numeric(m2b$beta)
P_m2a <- cum_probs(th_a, b_a * test$svd_score)
P_m2b <- cum_probs(th_b, b_b * test$svd_score)

# M2c from 09's cache (valid: the svd_score inputs are unchanged)
if (RUN_M2C) {
  m2c_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, "m2c_params.rds")
  stopifnot("Run 09 first: m2c_params.rds not found" = file.exists(m2c_cache))
  m2c_par <- readRDS(m2c_cache)
  bu_c <- m2c_par$ranef[as.character(test$userId)]
  bu_c[is.na(bu_c)] <- 0
  P_m2c <- cum_probs(m2c_par$Theta,
                     m2c_par$beta * test$svd_score + as.numeric(bu_c))
}

# M2d in full from 09's final cache (must be the eta=0.03/lambda=0.02 refit)
m2d_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, "m2d_final.rds")
stopifnot("Run 09 first: m2d_final.rds not found" = file.exists(m2d_cache))
m2d <- readRDS(m2d_cache)
th_d <- expand_thresholds(m2d$par$t1, m2d$par$beta)
cat(sprintf("Loaded M2d (best epoch %d, calib meanLL %.5f)\n",
            m2d$best_epoch, m2d$best_ll))
stopifnot(abs(m2d$best_ll - (-1.10002)) < 2e-4)  # guard: the stale pre-refit
# cache had calib -1.10080, only 8e-4 away, so the tolerance must be tight
P_m2d <- ordrec_probs_d(m2d$par, test$user_idx, test$movie_idx)
```

## 5. Initialisation for M2e



```{r inits}
dat_fit   <- list(u = fit$user_idx,   i = fit$movie_idx,   r = fit$rating5)
dat_calib <- list(u = calib$user_idx, i = calib$movie_idx, r = calib$rating5)
dat_test  <- list(u = test$user_idx,  i = test$movie_idx,  r = test$rating5)

marg5  <- prop.table(tabulate(dat_fit$r, K_LEVELS))
t_marg <- qlogis(cumsum(marg5)[1:4])
set.seed(SEED)
init_cold <- list(t1   = rep(t_marg[1], nU),
                  beta = matrix(log(pmax(diff(t_marg), 1e-3)), nU, 3, byrow = TRUE),
                  bi = rep(0, nI),
                  P = matrix(rnorm(nU * SVD_DIM, 0, 0.05), nU, SVD_DIM),
                  Q = matrix(rnorm(nI * SVD_DIM, 0, 0.05), nI, SVD_DIM))
cat("cold-start thresholds (all users):", round(t_marg, 4), "\n")
```

## 6. Final M2e Training

```{r final-train, fig.height=4}
final_cache <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, "m2e_final.rds")
if (file.exists(final_cache)) {
  m2e <- readRDS(final_cache)
  cat("Loaded cached final M2e.\n")
} else {
  m2e <- train_ordrec_m2e(dat_fit, dat_calib, init_cold,
                          eta = ETA, lambda = LAMBDA, verbose = TRUE)
  saveRDS(m2e, final_cache)
}
stopifnot(!m2e$diverged)
gap <- m2e$history[epoch == m2e$best_epoch,
                   fit_meanLL - calib_meanLL]
cat(sprintf("best epoch %d | calib meanLL %.5f | fit-calib gap %.4f | max clip rate %.5f%%\n",
            m2e$best_epoch, m2e$best_ll, gap, 100 * max(m2e$history$clip_rate)))

hc <- melt(m2e$history[, .(epoch, fit_meanLL, calib_meanLL)], id.vars = "epoch")
p_curve <- ggplot(hc, aes(epoch, value, colour = variable)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m2e$best_epoch, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(fit_meanLL = "steelblue",
                                 calib_meanLL = "coral"),
                      labels = c("fit", "calibration")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "M2e training curves",
       subtitle = "Dashed line: epoch with the best calibration likelihood (parameters kept).",
       x = "Epoch", y = "Mean log-likelihood", colour = NULL)
print(p_curve)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig11_m2e_training_curve.png"), p_curve,
       width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 150)
```

## 7. Test-Month Evaluation



```{r test-eval}
stopifnot(all(dat_test$u >= 1L & dat_test$u <= nU))
P_m2e <- ordrec_probs_e(m2e$par, dat_test$u, dat_test$i)

P_list <- list(M1 = P_m1, M2a = P_m2a, M2b = P_m2b)
if (RUN_M2C) P_list$M2c <- P_m2c
P_list$M2d <- P_m2d
P_list$M2e <- P_m2e

res_list <- lapply(P_list, metric_set, y = test$rating5)
metrics  <- rbindlist(lapply(names(res_list), function(m)
  cbind(data.table(model = m), res_list[[m]]$tbl)))
kable(metrics, digits = 4, caption = "Test month, all models")

rank_tbl <- rbindlist(lapply(names(P_list), function(m) {
  E <- as.numeric(tidy_probs(P_list[[m]]) %*% LEVELS5)
  f <- fcp_stat(E, test$rating5, test$userId)
  data.table(model = m,
             NDCG10 = ndcg_at_10(E, test$rating5, test$userId),
             FCP = f$FCP, n_pairs = f$n_pairs, n_users = f$n_users)
}))
kable(rank_tbl, digits = 6, caption = "Ranking metrics (users with >= 5 test ratings)")
```

```{r}
gd <- merge(gaps_e, lv_used, by = "user_idx")
kable(gd[, .(n_users = .N,
             g12 = median(g12), g23 = median(g23), g34 = median(g34)),
         by = .(full_scale = n_lv == 5L)][order(-full_scale)],
      digits = 3,
      caption = "Gap medians split by whether the user used all five levels in the fit set")
cat(sprintf("users using all 5 levels: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(gd$n_lv == 5L), nU, 100 * mean(gd$n_lv == 5L)))
```

### Per-user thresholds: heterogeneity and gap structure



```{r thresholds, fig.height=3.8}
Tall <- user_threshold_rows(m2e$par, seq_len(nU))
gaps_e <- data.table(g12 = Tall[, 2] - Tall[, 1],
                     g23 = Tall[, 3] - Tall[, 2],
                     g34 = Tall[, 4] - Tall[, 3])
gap_summary <- gaps_e[, .(gap = c("g12", "g23", "g34"),
                          median = sapply(.SD, median),
                          q25 = sapply(.SD, quantile, 0.25),
                          q75 = sapply(.SD, quantile, 0.75))]
kable(gap_summary, digits = 3,
      caption = "M2e per-user threshold gaps: median and IQR across users")

ref_gaps <- data.table(model = c("M2b", "M2c", "M2d", "M2e (median)"),
                       g12 = c(th_b[2] - th_b[1],
                               m2c_par$Theta[2] - m2c_par$Theta[1],
                               th_d[2] - th_d[1], median(gaps_e$g12)),
                       g23 = c(th_b[3] - th_b[2],
                               m2c_par$Theta[3] - m2c_par$Theta[2],
                               th_d[3] - th_d[2], median(gaps_e$g23)),
                       g34 = c(th_b[4] - th_b[3],
                               m2c_par$Theta[4] - m2c_par$Theta[3],
                               th_d[4] - th_d[3], median(gaps_e$g34)))
kable(ref_gaps, digits = 3,
      caption = "Threshold gaps across the ladder (does unequal spacing survive per-user freedom?)")

# does t1 track user generosity? (it should: t1_u absorbs -b_u)
user_meanr <- fit[, .(mean_r = mean(rating5)), by = user_idx]
t1_dt <- data.table(user_idx = seq_len(nU), t1 = m2e$par$t1)[user_meanr, on = "user_idx"]
p_t1 <- ggplot(t1_dt, aes(mean_r, t1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", colour = "coral", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Per-user first threshold vs. mean fit-set rating",
       subtitle = sprintf("Spearman rho = %.3f. Generous raters should sit lower (thresholds absorb -b_u).",
                          cor(t1_dt$mean_r, t1_dt$t1, method = "spearman")),
       x = "User mean rating (fit set)", y = expression(t[1]^{(u)}))
print(p_t1)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig12_m2e_t1_vs_meanrating.png"), p_t1,
       width = 7, height = 3.8, dpi = 150)
```

## 8. Cluster Bootstrap



```{r bootstrap, fig.height=3.9}
ll_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(res_list, function(r) r$row_ll))
colnames(ll_mat) <- names(res_list)

rows_by_user <- split(seq_len(nrow(test)), test$userId)
u_names <- names(rows_by_user)

set.seed(SEED)
others <- setdiff(colnames(ll_mat), "M1")
cmp_names <- c(paste0(others, " - M1"),
               if (RUN_M2C) "M2d - M2c", "M2e - M2d")
boot <- matrix(NA_real_, N_BOOT, length(cmp_names),
               dimnames = list(NULL, cmp_names))
for (b in seq_len(N_BOOT)) {
  idx <- unlist(rows_by_user[sample(u_names, length(u_names), replace = TRUE)],
                use.names = FALSE)
  mm  <- colMeans(ll_mat[idx, , drop = FALSE])
  boot[b, ] <- c(mm[others] - mm["M1"],
                 if (RUN_M2C) mm["M2d"] - mm["M2c"],
                 mm["M2e"] - mm["M2d"])
}
obs <- colMeans(ll_mat)
obs_diff <- c(obs[others] - obs["M1"],
              if (RUN_M2C) obs["M2d"] - obs["M2c"],
              obs["M2e"] - obs["M2d"])
ci <- data.table(comparison  = colnames(boot),
                 diff_meanLL = as.numeric(obs_diff),
                 lo = apply(boot, 2, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                 hi = apply(boot, 2, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
ci[, significant := (lo > 0) | (hi < 0)]
kable(ci, digits = 5,
      caption = sprintf("Cluster bootstrap, %d replicates, users resampled", N_BOOT))

p_ci <- ggplot(ci, aes(comparison, diff_meanLL)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), colour = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() + theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Gain in mean log-likelihood",
       subtitle = "95% cluster bootstrap intervals",
       x = NULL, y = "Difference in mean log-likelihood")
print(p_ci)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig13_m2e_bootstrap.png"), p_ci,
       width = 7, height = 3.9, dpi = 150)
```
